title: Vande Bharat Vada Mein Mila Metal Bolt: IRCTC Ne Caterer Par Liya Action
summary: Bengaluru se Belagavi ja rahi Vande Bharat train mein ek passenger ko vada mein metal bolt mila. IRCTC ne maafi mangi aur service provider par action liya hai.
key_points: Bengaluru-Belagavi Vande Bharat train ke meal mein mila bada metal bolt.
Passenger Samarth Kodial ne social media par video aur photos share kiye.
IRCTC ne maafi maangte hue service provider par strict action lene ki baat kahi.
Kitchen staff ko SOPs follow karne aur equipment check karne ke instruction diye gaye.
body: Bengaluru se Belagavi ja rahi Vande Bharat Express mein ek passenger ko apne khane mein bada metal bolt mila. Passenger Samarth Kodial ne X (pehle Twitter) par is incident ki photo aur video share ki, jisme vada ke paas ek zang laga hua bolt dikhai de raha hai. Unhone isse food quality mein ek bada lapse bataya.

Is post par dhyan dete hue Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) ne turant jawab diya. IRCTC ne passenger ko hui dikkat ke liye maafi maangi aur bataya ki is mamle ko gambhirta se lete hue concerned service provider ke khilaf strict action liya gaya hai.

IRCTC ne yeh bhi bataya ki kitchen staff ko food preparation ke dauran strict Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) follow karne ke instructions diye gaye hain. Saath hi officials ko kitchen ki achhi tarah inspection karne aur khana banane se pehle sabhi equipment check karne ko kaha gaya hai taaki aisi galti dobara na ho.
Is incident ke baad social media par logon ne IRCTC aur catering service ki kafi alochna ki aur food safety standards par sawal uthaye.
why_it_matters: Premium trains mein journey karne wale passengers ke liye food hygiene aur safety bahut zaroori hai. Aise incidents se pata chalta hai ki catering quality aur food inspection par strict monitoring kitni zaroori hai.
